goodput_vs_loss_rate.reason: No actual nonzero loss-rate measurements exist; live actual execution rejects impaired channels.

goodput_vs_window_size.reason: Actual evidence does not vary window size within an implemented protocol and fixed control settings.

retransmissions_vs_reordering_probabilit.reason: No successful actual records declare that reordering impairment was applied; configured probability alone is not evidence of applied reordering.

rto_sensitivity.reason: Configured RTO does not vary across controlled actual runs, so sensitivity cannot be assessed. Configured RTO is not the same as a measured RTO; timeout-derived samples are only present when timeouts occur.
